basic_details.job_title: RVNL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Joint General Manager / Senior Deputy General Manager Posts
basic_details.short_information: Rail Vikas Nigam Limited (RVNL) is filling one post of Joint General Manager / Sr. Deputy General Manager (S&T) at Lucknow on deputation, with pay as parent pay plus deputation allowance. The duration is five years, subject to Government's approval for exemption to RVNL from the rule of immediate absorption. Candidates must be below 56 years and must apply through proper channel on the prescribed proforma at www.rvnl.org - Career - Jobs. A scanned copy must also be emailed to [email protected]. The closing date is 30 days from the date of issue, 18 November 2026, which is about 18 December 202

age_limit.details: The age limit is below 56 years. The cut off date for age and eligibility is reckoned as on the closing date of the vacancy notice. The notice prints no age relaxation.

how_to_apply: Get the prescribed proforma for submission of applications on deputation basis from www.rvnl.org - Career - Jobs. It is also printed on pages 3 and 4 of the notice.
Fill in the proforma completely and sign it. The notice says not to leave blanks in the Vacancy Notice No., the post applied for and the choice of station where applicable.
Apply through proper channel for selection on deputation basis.
Send a scanned copy of the duly filled in and signed proforma in PDF format directly by e-mail to [email protected] as an advance copy.
The closing date is 30 days from the date of issue, 18 November 2026.
The concerned controlling officer / zonal railways etc. may forward the applications of only eligible candidates to [email protected] within 15 days of the closing date.
Duly filled in and signed prescribed proforma.
Vigilance/DAR clearance, forwarded by the controlling officer.
Last 05 years APAR grading, forwarded by the controlling officer; copies of APARs/grading are to be attached to the proforma.

Personal data: name, gender, service, department, category, date of birth, age as on closing date, date of entry into time scale (DITS), date of entry in Group B where applicable, present grade/pay level (7th CPC) and basic pay, present post and contact details.
Present organisation address, Personnel/HR department contact details and email, and a photograph.
Educational qualifications, experience details, previous deputation or foreign assignment, and whether debarred from deputation.
Whether the cooling off period is completed, APAR ratings for the last 5 years, awards, punishments in career and whether presently undergoing punishment.
important_instructions: Only officers holding the posts and service listed under Who Can Apply are eligible. The vacancy notice number appears on the top right side of the notice and must be entered in the proforma. The controlling officer may forward the applications of only eligible candidates. The advance email copy from the candidate does not replace applying through proper channel.

content_sections.heading: About RVNL
content_sections.text: Rail Vikas Nigam Ltd. (RVNL) has its registered office at World Trade Center, Tower A, 6th to 9th Floor, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi- 110029. This vacancy notice was signed by the Joint General Manager/HR. It invites officers for selection on deputation basis against the one post at Lucknow.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites officers of the IRSSE / S&T Department. The minimum eligibility is given separately for each level. Officers holding substantively: posts in analogous grade (CDA/IDA); OR posts in Level-12 (CDA) and having 8-12 years' service in Group 'A'; OR posts carrying grade IDA E-5 (Rs. 80000-220000/-) for four years. Officers holding substantively: posts in analogous grade (CDA/IDA); OR posts in Sr. Scale (Level-11); OR posts in Gr. 'B' (Level-10) and having 10 years of service in Group 'B' (Gazetted); OR posts carrying grade IDA E-4 (Rs. 70000-200000/-) for four years. Preference shall be given to candidates having relevant experience in telecom infrastructure, NLD networks, broadband connectivity, optical fibre cable (OFC) network planning, laying, construction, maintenance and operations, IT/ITES, communication systems and networking. Experience in execution, supervision, monitoring and coordination of telecom/infrastructure projects, including project planning, contract management and field-level implementation, shall also be considered relevant. The age limit is below 56 years. The cut off date for age and eligibility is reckoned as on the closing date of the vacancy notice. The notice prints no age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Scale of pay: parent pay plus deputation allowance. The notice prints no rupee amount for the pay. Terms of appointment: deputation. Duration: five years, subject to Government's approval for exemption to RVNL from the rule of immediate absorption. Location: Lucknow.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RVNL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Get the prescribed proforma for submission of applications on deputation basis from www.rvnl.org - Career - Jobs. It is also printed on pages 3 and 4 of the notice. Fill in the proforma completely and sign it. The notice says not to leave blanks in the Vacancy Notice No., the post applied for and the choice of station where applicable. Apply through proper channel for selection on deputation basis. Send a scanned copy of the duly filled in and signed proforma in PDF format directly by e-mail to [email protected] as an advance copy. The closing date is 30 days from the date of issue, 18 November 2026. The concerned controlling officer / zonal railways etc. may forward the applications of only eligible candidates to [email protected] within 15 days of the closing date. Duly filled in and signed prescribed proforma. Vigilance/DAR clearance, forwarded by the controlling officer. Last 05 years APAR grading, forwarded by the controlling officer; copies of APARs/grading are to be attached to the proforma. Personal data: name, gender, service, department, category, date of birth, age as on closing date, date of entry into time scale (DITS), date of entry in Group B where applicable, present grade/pay level (7th CPC) and basic pay, present post and contact details. Present organisation address, Personnel/HR department contact details and email, and a photograph. Educational qualifications, experience details, previous deputation or foreign assignment, and whether debarred from deputation. Whether the cooling off period is completed, APAR ratings for the last 5 years, awards, punishments in career and whether presently undergoing punishment.

content_sections.text: Only officers holding the posts and service listed under Who Can Apply are eligible.
